title: TypeScript Error Audit
scope: All TypeScript type errors in mcp-server

summary.discrepancy_note: Baseline claim of 28 errors is severely outdated

TS2300_duplicate_identifier.description: Duplicate type identifiers in barrel export (src/engines/index.ts)
TS2300_duplicate_identifier.root_cause: Multiple engines export same type names (ToolGeometry, ISOGroup, etc.)
TS2300_duplicate_identifier.fix_approach: Use 'export type { X as EngineSpecificX }' aliasing or consolidate types

TS2559_interface_mismatch.description: Algorithm input types don't extend AlgorithmInput properly
TS2559_interface_mismatch.root_cause: AlgorithmInput base interface changed but 28 algorithms not updated
TS2559_interface_mismatch.fix_approach: Batch update algorithm input interfaces to extend AlgorithmInput correctly

TS2739_missing_properties.root_cause: ValidationResult interface expanded but algorithm validate() methods not updated
TS2739_missing_properties.fix_approach: Add missing properties to return objects in all validate() implementations

TS2322_type_assignment.root_cause: Algorithm category union type too narrow; other misc mismatches
TS2322_type_assignment.fix_approach: Expand category union type; fix individual type mismatches

TS2339_property_does_not_exist.description: Property access on types that don't have the property
TS2339_property_does_not_exist.fix_approach: Add missing properties to interfaces or fix property access

TS2345_argument_type_mismatch.description: Function argument type doesn't match parameter type
TS2345_argument_type_mismatch.fix_approach: Add .toString() calls or type assertions for buffer handling

priority_1_blocking.description: Errors that may block functionality at runtime

tasks.task: Fix property access errors in KnowledgeIngestionOrchestratorEngine.ts
tasks.approach: Verify interface definitions or add optional chaining

tasks.task: Fix buffer vs string issues in CAD/program engines

tasks.approach: Make AlgorithmInput properties optional or add common properties
Add errors: [] and warnings: [] to all validate() returns

priority_3_cosmetic.description: Style/strictness issues that don't affect runtime

tasks.task: Resolve barrel export duplicates in engines/index.ts
tasks.approach: Alias conflicting exports or consolidate shared types
Align dispatcher return types with schemas

recommended_approach: Fix priority_2 first (systematic batch fixes), then priority_1, then priority_3

critical: 238 errors is 8.5x higher than claimed 28 - baseline is stale
28 algorithm files have identical 3-error pattern - single interface fix covers 84 errors
KnowledgeIngestionOrchestratorEngine has 16 errors - likely partially implemented
observations: Most errors are interface alignment issues, not logic bugs
Buffer vs string issues suggest recent API changes in file parsing
Barrel export duplicates are annoying but don't affect runtime
